rounds.text: Raj Rayon Industries Ltd is showing fundamental momentum that vastly outpaces its current depressed stock price, which sits near its 52-week low with negative 1-year and 3-year returns [E5, E23, E24]. Operational efficiency is exceptionally strong, demonstrated by a trailing return on equity of 26.8% [E13] and a 3-year median ROE of 16% [E25], both well ahead of the sector benchmark of 10.03% [E9]. Growth has accelerated dramatically, with trailing twelve-month sales up 39% [E16] and profit growth surging by 146% [E20], supported by a robust 5-year profit CAGR of 24% [E18]. Cash generation is pristine, evidenced by an extraordinary cash conversion of 3.50x in March 2026 [E31], ₹119 Cr in operating cash flow [E32], and ₹71 Cr in free cash flow [E33], while borrowings simultaneously fell from ₹262 Cr to ₹222 Cr [E36] and capital-expenditure overhang essentially cleared with CWIP plunging 99.0% [E37]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of ₹24 per share provides a margin of safety against the current ₹20.4 market price [E41], and a reverse DCF reveals that the market is only pricing in 15.5% growth against an assumed 18.0% base case [E43]. Conceded: the debt-to-equity ratio sits at an elevated 1.41x [E35], the price-to-book multiple of 7.26x exceeds the sector benchmark of 3.02x [E7], and the dividend yield is zero [E4].
